Message.Name: New Order Long Form Message
Message.Description: Long form of the New Order request provides full flexibility of configuring order attributes: simple and multi-leg instruments (up to 10 legs), clearing overrides, preferenced, AON/FOK, reserve and attributable orders, one-sided auction initiation (Block, Exposure and Flex auctions), auction responses and Do Not Trade Through orders. Acknowledged by Order Accepted (Long Form).

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange; all four characters will be provided to OCC

Field.Name: OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Field.Name: PreferredParty
Field.Description: IFI of the preferred Market Maker. Blank if none.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Should be set to 0 if Order Type = M.

Field.Name: AuctionId
Field.Description: Identifies the Auction being responded. 0 if this order is not an auction response.

Field.Name: AuctionDuration
Field.Description: User defined field for Auction Duration. In milliseconds between 3,000 and 300,000. Only required for Flex auctions. Must be 0 for Non-Flex Auctions.

Field.Name: DisclosureMask
Field.Description: See Disclosure Mask Field (bits 0-5: Firm, Clearing Account, CMTA Account, Side, Price, Quantity; a set bit makes the attribute visible)

Field.Name: PositionEffectMask
Field.Description: See Position Effect Mask Field (bit n = leg n; set bit = Open, cleared bit = Close)

Field.Name: StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sell Short, E=Sell Short Exempt. If this is a multi-leg order for a stock combo where stock leg is on the Sell side StockLegShortSale may be set to H or E. In all other cases value N should be used.

Field.Name: StockCapacity
Field.Description: P=Principal, A=Agency, R=Riskless Principal, space=Not Applicable

Field.Name: Number of Flex Legs
Field.Description: To be used for notifying Leg Deltas on Delta-Adjusted At Close feature as well as Leg Prices on Flex instruments. It will be 0 for non-Flex instruments.

Message.Name: New Order Short Form Message
Message.Description: Short format of the New Order request is a compact message (50 bytes) with limited flexibility: simple and multi-leg instruments, quantity up to 65535, auction responses, default clearing configuration for the Firm. Acknowledged by Order Accepted (Short Form).

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Should be set to 0 if Order Type = M.

Field.Name: AuctionId
Field.Description: Identifies the Auction being responded. 0 if this order is not an auction response.

Field.Name: StockCapacity
Field.Description: P=Principal, A=Agency, R=Riskless Principal, space=Not Applicable

Message.Name: Replace Order Message
Message.Description: Replace Order message is used to modify an existing order for both simple and complex instruments. It can also be used to alter price of the contra side of Cross Orders. The order to be replaced is identified by OrigClOrdId.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier of the order to be replaced. If no open order with such identifier is found, request is rejected.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier for the replacement order. See Client Order Id.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total Intended Order Quantity (including the amount already executed for this chain of orders)

Message.Name: Cancel Order Message
Message.Description: Cancel Order by Client ID. Deletes a single simple order, a single complex order, or a Cross Order (terminating an ongoing auction). The order to be deleted is identified by the ClOrdId field.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier of the order to be canceled. If no open order with such identifier is found, request is rejected.

Message.Name: Mass Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message is used to mass-delete multiple open orders based on the specified Scope. The sequence of Order Canceled messages is terminated with a single Mass Cancel Response.

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the request. It is echoed back with either Mass Cancel Response or Reject

Field.Name: InstrumentType
Field.Description: A=All, O=Simple Instrument, C=Standard Combination, S=Stock Combination

Field.Name: Scope
Field.Description: Scope of the deletion request: P=Product (requires ProductID, InstrumentID must be 0), I=Instrument (requires InstrumentID, ProductID must be 0), F=Firm (ProductId and InstrumentId must be set to zero)

Field.Name: ProductId
Field.Description: Product (Underlying) ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications. Must be populated if Scope=P and UnderlyingSymbol not populated.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications. Must be populated if Scope=I

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: Denotes the unique underlying stock symbol for the option symbol. Must be populated if Scope = P and ProductID not populated.

Message.Name: New Cross Order Message
Message.Description: Cross Order message allows specifying two opposite sides to trade against each other. The primary side of the order is exposed in an auction if CrossType is set to A (Auction). Other cross types (QCC and CCC) trade the two sides without market exposure. The Primary Side and Contra Side blocks of the document are carried as Primary and Contra prefixed fields.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Instrument Directory Messages

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: See Auction Type Field. If CrossType is set to A, acceptable values are P, H, S, X. For other CrossTypes value N must be used

Field.Name: AuctionAllocPct
Field.Description: Order Allocation percentage 0 <= n <= 40. 0 for Simple and Complex Solicitation.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the primary part of the Cross Order. Contra part is implied to be on the opposite side. B=Buy, S=Sell

Field.Name: EffectiveTime
Field.Description: Agreed upon time for the stopped price. UTC time in milliseconds.

Field.Name: AuctionDuration
Field.Description: User defined field for Auction Duration. In Milliseconds between 3,000 and 300,000. Only required for Flex auctions. Must be 0 for others.

Field.Name: Primary ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange; all four characters will be provided to OCC

Field.Name: Primary OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Field.Name: Primary Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Primary Side of a Cross order cannot be Market.

Field.Name: Primary StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sell Short, E=Sell Short Exempt. If this is a multi-leg order for a stock combo where stock leg is on the Sell side StockLegShortSale may be set to H or E. In all other cases value N should be used.

Field.Name: Primary StockCapacity
Field.Description: P=Principal, A=Agency, R=Riskless Principal, space=Not Applicable

Field.Name: Contra ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange; all four characters will be provided to OCC

Field.Name: Contra OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Field.Name: Contra Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Should be set to 0 if Order Type = M.

Field.Name: Contra StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sell Short, E=Sell Short Exempt. If this is a multi-leg order for a stock combo where stock leg is on the Sell side StockLegShortSale may be set to H or E. In all other cases value N should be used.

Field.Name: Contra StockCapacity
Field.Description: P=Principal, A=Agency, R=Riskless Principal, space=Not Applicable

Field.Name: Number of Flex Legs
Field.Description: To be used for notifying Leg Deltas on Delta-Adjusted At Close feature as well as Leg Prices on Flex instruments. It will be 0 for non-Flex instruments.

Message.Name: Add Complex Instrument Message
Message.Description: This is a variable length message where length is controlled by the number of legs in the instrument. Results in Add Complex Instrument Response and Complex Instrument Directory messages, or a Reject.

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the request. It is echoed back with either Add Complex Instrument Response or Reject

Field.Name: ProductId
Field.Description: Product (Underlying) ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications; must be provided if ProductName is blank

Field.Name: ProductName
Field.Description: Product (Underlying) name; must be provided if ProductID = 0

Message.Name: Modify Trade Message
Message.Description: The Modify Trade request is used to change clearing information on an existing trade as well as split a trade into multiple components with different clearing assignments. The trade to be changed is identified by the MatchId field. Acknowledged by Modify Trade Response.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the request. It is echoed back with either Modify Trade Response or Reject

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Identifies Order whose execution is being modified

Field.Name: CrossId
Field.Description: CrossId of the trade being modified

Field.Name: MatchId
Field.Description: MatchId of the trade to be modified

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side where modifications are to be made

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Size of the trade being split

Field.Name: NumSplits
Field.Description: Number of parties this trade is being split into (1 <= n <= 10)

Message.Name: Member Kill Switch Request Message
Message.Description: The Member Kill Switch Request is used to block ability to enter new orders, alter existing orders, delete orders, and create complex instruments. Scope of the Kill Switch Request is one firm per request. Answered by Member Kill Switch Notification or Reject.

Field.Name: TargetFirmID
Field.Description: Firm ID being targeted by the Kill Switch Request

Field.Name: KillAction
Field.Description: A=Block Entry of new requests and delete all open orders

Message.Name: Subscription Request Message
Message.Description: Subscription Request message allows client to modify the set of optional notification types it receives on the OTTO connection for the current session. Supported on PHLX, ISE, GEMX and MRX. Answered by Subscription Response or Reject.

Field.Name: Subscription
Field.Description: A list of notification types to be included in the current session, 0 or more types padded with spaces on the right: S=Simple Instrument Directory, s=Complex Instrument Directory, H=Instrument Trading Action, A=Auction Notification, T=Trade Details (only for the OTTO connection the subscription request was sent)

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event message informs of a market or a session-level event.

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: Version of OTTO Interface. Currently set to 3

Field.Name: Sub-version
Field.Description: Sub-version of the interface. Currently set to 0.

Message.Name: Simple Instrument Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day and during intra-day market state changes, the system disseminates directory messages for all symbols trading on the system.

Field.Name: ClosingType
Field.Description: N=Normal Hours, L=Late Hours, W=WCO Early Closing at 12:00 Noon, E=Extended Close (extended trading hours edition)

Field.Name: Closing Only
Field.Description: N=Unrestricted, Y=Option is Closing Position Only. Only MM origin orders can have open position in the series

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Industry assigned security symbol for the option contract

Message.Name: Complex Instrument Directory Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever new complex strategy is created on the system. InstrumentId of a complex strategy is unique for the trading day across both simple and complex instruments.

Message.Name: Instrument Trading Action Message
Message.Description: This message notifies of changes to the trading status of an instrument.

Field.Name: TradingState
Field.Description: H=Halted, T=Trading. At the start of day all instruments are assumed to be Trading unless notified as Halted by this message.

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: Auction Notification message announces that a new Auction has started in the market for Nasdaq PHLX, ISE, GEMX and MRX. Auction orders include Block, Complex Exposure, Simple Exposed order, Facilitation, Solicitation, and PIM.

Field.Name: InstrumentType
Field.Description: O=Simple Instrument, C=Standard Combination, S=Stock Combination

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Instrument Directory notifications

Field.Name: AuctionId
Field.Description: Identifies new Auction. AuctionId is unique across all instruments for the duration of the trading session.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price/Premium. 0 if price is Not Disclosed or a Market order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity. 0 if volume is not disclosed.

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: Spaces when auction not flagged Attributable

Field.Name: OCCAccount
Field.Description: Account number used for clearing give up. 0 when auction not flagged Attributable

Field.Name: AuctionEvent
Field.Description: S=Start, U=Auction Update, E=End of Auction

Field.Name: AuctionDuration
Field.Description: User defined field for Auction Duration. In Milliseconds between 3,000 and 300,000. Populated only for Flex instruments and only valid for Start of Auction event S; 0 otherwise.

Field.Name: BestResponsePrice
Field.Description: Best response price; 0 if not disclosed. BestResponsePrice of 0 is valid for Exposure auctions if BestResponseSize is not 0

Field.Name: BestResponseSize
Field.Description: Aggregated quantity at Best response price; 0 if not disclosed

Field.Name: Number of Flex DAC Legs
Field.Description: To be used in future to support Delta-Adjusted at Close functionality on Flex.

Message.Name: Order Accepted Long Form Message
Message.Description: Acknowledges the receipt and acceptance of a valid New Order (Long Form). The data fields from the New Order Message are echoed back. Order Accepted messages always come before any Order Executed or Order Canceled Messages for an order. Does not include Leg Prices or Auction Duration.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Day-unique Order identifier assigned by exchange

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange

Field.Name: OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Field.Name: PreferredParty
Field.Description: IFI of the preferred Market Maker. Blank if none.

Field.Name: AuctionId
Field.Description: Identifies the Auction being responded. 0 if this order is not an auction response.

Field.Name: StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sell Short, E=Sell Short Exempt

Field.Name: StockCapacity
Field.Description: P=Principal, A=Agency, R=Riskless Principal, space=Not Applicable

Field.Name: Number of Flex Legs
Field.Description: To be used for notifying Leg Deltas on Delta-Adjusted At Close feature as well as Leg Prices on Flex Instruments. It will be 0 for non-Flex instruments.

Message.Name: Order Accepted Short Form Message
Message.Description: This message is used to acknowledge a valid order submitted via New Order (Short Form).

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Day-unique Order identifier assigned by exchange

Field.Name: AuctionId
Field.Description: Identifies the Auction being responded. 0 if this order is not an auction response.

Field.Name: StockCapacity
Field.Description: P=Principal, A=Agency, R=Riskless Principal, space=Not Applicable

Message.Name: Order Replaced Message
Message.Description: Acknowledges a Replace Order request.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: OrigOrderId
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the replaced order

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the replacement order

Field.Name: OrigClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier of the replaced order

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier of the replacement order

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of open contracts after replacement

Field.Name: AuctionId
Field.Description: Identifies the Auction being responded. 0 if this order is not an auction response.

Message.Name: Order Canceled Message
Message.Description: An Order Canceled Message informs you that an order has been fully canceled. This could be acknowledging a Cancel Order Message, or it could be the result of the order being canceled automatically by the system.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the canceled order

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier of the canceled order

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed message reports an execution of an order for a simple instrument, a complex instrument, or an option or stock leg of a complex order.

Field.Name: OrdExecType
Field.Description: Type of the execution being reported: A=Execution of an order for a simple instrument (option), B=Execution of an order for a complex instrument, C=Execution of an option leg of a complex order, D=Execution of a stock leg of a complex order

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Instrument Directory notifications. Identifies a Combo Instrument if OrdExecType is B, C or D.

Field.Name: LegInstrumentId
Field.Description: Leg Instrument ID. Only populated for OrdExecType=C. Zero otherwise.

Field.Name: LegId
Field.Description: 0-based LegId within complex instrument identified by the InstrumentId field. Only meaningful for OrdExecType C or D.

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the executed order

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier of the executed order

Field.Name: CrossId
Field.Description: An order that matches against one or more opposing orders or quotes generates a cross for each price level executed. CrossId is unique for the day within entire trading system.

Field.Name: MatchId
Field.Description: Cross consists of one or more execution pairs. Each side of such a pair carries a unique MatchId.

Field.Name: StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sold Short, E=Sold Short Exempt

Message.Name: Trade Details Message
Message.Description: A Trade Details message contains additional details, specifically clearing information. This message is sent out with a nominal delay after Order Executed message. Trade Busts and Adjustments are made against individual MatchIds; Modify Trade results are reported with TransType B for the original trade and C for the new trades.

Field.Name: OrdExecType
Field.Description: Type of the execution being reported: A=Execution of an order for a simple instrument (option), C=Execution of an option leg of a complex order, D=Execution of a stock leg of a complex order

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Instrument Directory notifications. Identifies a Combo Instrument if OrdExecType is C or D.

Field.Name: LegInstrumentId
Field.Description: Leg Instrument ID. Only populated for OrdExecType=C. Zero otherwise.

Field.Name: LegId
Field.Description: Only meaningful for OrdExecType C or D. Identifies leg within complex strategy.

Field.Name: TransType
Field.Description: A=New Trade, B=Trade Busted, C=Modified Trade

Field.Name: EventSource
Field.Description: A=Matching Engine, M=Manual Trade Entry, U=Trade Modification (user), C=Trade Modification (contra-side user), E=Trade Modification (exchange), B=Trade Bust (exchange)

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Exchange ID of the executed order

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Client Order Identifier of the executed order

Field.Name: CrossId
Field.Description: An order that matches against one or more opposing orders or quotes generates a cross for each price level executed. CrossId is unique for the day within entire trading system.

Field.Name: MatchId
Field.Description: Cross consists of one or more execution pairs. Each side of such a pair carries a unique MatchId.

Field.Name: RefMatchId
Field.Description: For TransType=C indicates MatchId of the original trade. 0 (zero) for TransType=A, B

Field.Name: StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sold Short, E=Sold Short Exempt

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange

Field.Name: OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Message.Name: Cross Order Accepted Message
Message.Description: Acknowledges a valid New Cross Order. The Primary Side and Contra Side blocks of the document are carried as Primary and Contra prefixed fields.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Instrument Directory Messages

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: See Auction Type Field. If CrossType is set to A, possible values are P, H, S. For other CrossTypes value N must be used

Field.Name: AuctionId
Field.Description: Identifies the Auction being accepted. 0 if this order is not an auction.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the primary part of the Cross Order. Contra part is implied to be on the opposite side. B=Buy, S=Sell

Field.Name: EffectiveTime
Field.Description: Agreed upon time for the stopped price. UTC time in milliseconds.

Field.Name: Primary OrderId
Field.Description: Day-unique Order identifier assigned by exchange

Field.Name: Primary ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange

Field.Name: Primary OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Field.Name: Primary Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Primary Side of a Cross order cannot be Market.

Field.Name: Primary StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sell Short, E=Sell Short Exempt. If this is a multi-leg order for a stock combo where stock leg is on the Sell side StockLegShortSale may be set to H or E. In all other cases value N should be used.

Field.Name: Contra OrderId
Field.Description: Day-unique Order identifier assigned by exchange

Field.Name: Contra ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange

Field.Name: Contra OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Field.Name: Contra Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Should be set to 0 if Order Type = M.

Field.Name: Contra StockLegShortSale
Field.Description: N=Not Applicable, H=Sell Short, E=Sell Short Exempt. If this is a multi-leg order for a stock combo where stock leg is on the Sell side StockLegShortSale may be set to H or E. In all other cases value N should be used.

Message.Name: Member Kill Switch Notification Message
Message.Description: The Member Kill Switch Notification informs of a Member Kill Switch Request issued by this OTTO account, or a Kill Switch Action (User or System initiated) targeting Firm ID(s) associated with this OTTO account.

Field.Name: FirmID
Field.Description: Firm ID issuing the request, blank if system initiated

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the request, blank if system initiated

Field.Name: TargetFirmID
Field.Description: Firm ID affected by the Kill Switch Request

Field.Name: KillAction
Field.Description: A=Block Entry of new requests and delete all open orders, R=Kill-switch block removed (by Exchange support personnel), B=Block entry of new requests

Message.Name: Mass Cancel Response Message
Message.Description: Mass Cancel Response is sent out upon completion of processing of a valid Mass Cancel Request.

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the Mass Cancel Request

Field.Name: NumPending
Field.Description: Number of orders where cancelation is pending due to paused instrument state

Message.Name: Add Complex Instrument Response Message
Message.Description: Add Complex Instrument Response indicates successful creation of new Complex Instrument using Add Complex Instrument Request.

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the Add Complex Instrument Request

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument (Strategy) ID assigned to the newly created instrument

Message.Name: Modify Trade Response Message
Message.Description: Modify Trade Response is sent when a valid Modify Trade Request is accepted.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Options Directory notifications

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the Modify Trade Request

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Identifies Order whose execution is being modified

Field.Name: CrossId
Field.Description: CrossId of the trade being modified

Field.Name: MatchId
Field.Description: MatchId of the trade being modified

Message.Name: Subscription Response Message
Message.Description: Subscription Response is sent after a valid Subscription Request has been processed.

Field.Name: ClRequestId
Field.Description: Client identifier of the Subscribe Request

Message.Name: Reject Message
Message.Description: Reject is sent in response to a Request that is deemed invalid. Reject message contains error code explaining the reason for rejection.

Field.Name: RejectMsgType
Field.Description: Type of the message being rejected

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Client order Id or Request Id of the message being rejected

Field.Name: RejectCode
Field.Description: Reason for the reject. See Reject Codes

Message.Name: Pending Response Message
Message.Description: A Pending Response is sent by OTTO when a Request cannot be immediately, fully processed or validated, and indicates that the final status of the Request is not yet known (typically, any Request for a pending instrument). It is eventually followed by the Notification associated with the Request or a Reject.

Field.Name: InstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Option Directory notifications

Field.Name: PendingMsgType
Field.Description: Type of the message placed in pending state

Group.Name: Flex Leg Prices
Group.Description: Leg Definitions (1-10) of New Order (Long Form) and New Cross Order: Leg Prices on Flex instruments, to be used for Leg Deltas on the Delta-Adjusted At Close feature

Group.Name: Flex Legs
Group.Description: Leg Definitions (1-10) of Order Accepted (Long Form); leg prices are not echoed

Group.Name: Flex Dac Legs
Group.Description: Leg Definitions (1-10) of Auction Notification, to be used in future to support Delta-Adjusted at Close functionality on Flex

Group.Name: Complex Instrument Legs
Group.Description: Leg Definitions (2-10) of Add Complex Instrument

Field.Name: LegInstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Simple Option Directory notifications. Use 0 for a Stock Leg.

Group.Name: Complex Directory Legs
Group.Description: Leg Definitions (2-10) of Complex Instrument Directory

Field.Name: LegInstrumentId
Field.Description: Instrument ID, as specified by Simple Option Directory notifications. 0 for a Stock Leg.

Field.Name: LegId
Field.Description: Leg identifier within this strategy. This is an exchange-assigned 0-based index. E.g. Nth leg has LegId=N-1.

Group.Name: Trade Splits
Group.Description: Trade Splits [1..10] of Modify Trade: clearing configuration for each party the trade is being split into

Field.Name: AllocQty
Field.Description: Quantity being allocated to the specified clearing configuration

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Sub-account/MM Identifier at the registered exchange (blanks=remove); all four characters will be provided to OCC.

Field.Name: OCCAccount
Field.Description: OCC # to use for clearing (give up)

Field.Name: StockCapacity
Field.Description: P=Principal, A=Agency, R=Riskless Principal, space=Not Applicable

Value.Name: Buy
Value.Description: Buy (Bought on executions, Bid on Auction Notification)

Value.Name: Joint Back Office
Value.Description: Joint BackOffice (JBO). Supported on PHLX and NOM; placeholder on ISE, GEMX and MRX

Value.Name: Joint Back Office
Value.Description: Joint BackOffice (JBO). Supported on PHLX and NOM; placeholder on ISE, GEMX and MRX

Value.Name: None
Value.Description: Order is neither an initiation nor a response to an Auction

Value.Name: Sell Short Exempt
Value.Description: Sell Short Exempt (Sold Short Exempt on executions)

Value.Name: Product
Value.Description: Cancel all open orders for the specified FirmID/ProductID/InstrumentType

Value.Name: Instrument
Value.Description: Cancel all the open orders for the specified FirmID/InstrumentID

Value.Name: Firm
Value.Description: Cancel all open orders for the specified FirmID/InstrumentType

Value.Name: Block And Delete
Value.Description: Block Entry of new requests and delete all open orders

Value.Name: Block Removed
Value.Description: Kill-switch block removed (by Exchange support personnel)

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. This is always the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: Start of System Hours. The system is up and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Opening Process
Value.Description: Start of Opening Process. The system has started its opening process.

Value.Name: End of Wco Early Closing
Value.Description: End of WCO Early closing. No new orders or changes to existing orders on last trading date of WCO options.

Value.Name: End of Normal Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Normal Hours Processing. No new executions for options that trade during normal hours.

Value.Name: End of Late Hours Processing
Value.Description: End of Late Hours Processing. No new executions for options that trade during extended hours.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: End of System Hours. The system is now closed.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Closing Position Only
Value.Description: Option is Closing Position Only. Only MM origin orders can have open position in the series

Value.Name: Simple Instrument
Value.Description: Execution of an order for a simple instrument (option)

Value.Name: Complex Instrument
Value.Description: Execution of an order for a complex instrument

Value.Name: Complex Option Leg
Value.Description: Execution of an option leg of a complex order

Value.Name: Complex Stock Leg
Value.Description: Execution of a stock leg of a complex order

Value.Name: User Requested
Value.Description: User requested cancel. Sent in response to a Cancel Message

Value.Name: Immediate or Cancel
Value.Description: Immediate or Cancel order. No further matches were available on the book so the remaining unexecuted contracts were immediately canceled

Value.Name: Supervisory
Value.Description: Supervisory. This order was manually canceled by an Exchange supervisory terminal

Value.Name: Regulatory Restriction
Value.Description: This order cannot be executed because of a regulatory restriction (e.g. trade through restrictions)
